info.name: EventFlow Complete Backend
info.description: End-to-end EventFlow API collection. Recommended workflow: Super/Admin login → Attendee registration/OTP → Organizer apply/OTP → Admin approval → Organizer login → Category → Event → Ticket Type → Event review/publish → Checkout/UddoktaPay → Tickets/check-in → refunds/transfers/waitlist/disputes/payouts/analytics. UddoktaPay hosted checkout must be completed in a browser; the backend verifies payment server-side.
